name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthi missiles at Riyadh; Gaza 7 killed 10 Nov
summary: Houthi missiles at Riyadh intercepted as Saudi-backed offensive in Yemen goes on; Israeli fire killed 7 in Gaza 10 Nov
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia, and the Houthis said they targeted an Aramco facility at Abqaiq, as Yemen's government pressed a coalition-backed offensive with air strikes, reported 11 Nov (Al Jazeera). The WHO counts at least 1,771 killed in Yemen since August. In Gaza, health officials said Israeli strikes and gunfire killed at least seven people on 10 Nov despite the ceasefire (Al-Monitor, carrying Reuters). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front set the Alert.
for_you: Missile and drone attacks can disrupt flights and travel in Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and the Palestinian territories. Anyone travelling in the region should follow FCDO travel advice and local authority instructions.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes: Houthi missiles at Riyadh and Saudi-led air strikes in Yemen, reported 10–11 Nov

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Yemeni forces, Houthis exchange attacks, claim to inflict heavy losses
